preconditions.description: The number of bowls of food is between 1 and 200,000.
The time when the dog is stopped is between 1 and 2*10^9.
The time when each bowl of food is ready for eating is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum number of bowls of food the dog will be able to eat in T seconds.
